description: Proposed refinements of the catalogue's technique conditions ('Applies when (flags, proposed)'). Each entry records the catalogue value it replaces; the build fails if that value changes in the catalogue. Status: proposed, pending review.

techniques.why: The technique turns a language model into a social engineer that converses with users, so it needs a generative system.
Impersonation reaches the system through generated content or by deceiving identity verification; a non-generative system that does not verify identity is not exposed.
